ACTING_DEPLOYMENT_locked.why: States are visited under the live CLOSEST_DEFENDS allocator so the distilled arms train on the same role-structured state distribution the Separated arm sees.

KL_TEACHERS_locked.note: Acting policies generate the state distribution; KL teachers are the two single-strategy entity-repair specialists queried on every stored observation (same procedure as 2v2).

DATASET.entities_required: entity-repair teachers fail closed without teammates/enemies tensors at distillation time

SEEDS.chosen_by: seed_registry next_free + allocate before this freeze; fresh -- disjoint from the invalidated collection's 22520001-22520196
SEEDS.student_init_and_shuffle: allocated by the distillation spec, not here

POLES.source: the governing 4v4 certification (STRATEGIC_DEMAND_4v4_POLE_B3_3_N192_CERTIFICATION.json) through pole_attestation; the collector refuses if these overlays disagree with the certified poles, and asserts the live overlay each episode
POLES.size_normalized_gate: live min_alive_for_defender must equal 4 (NOT a pole check: plain OP7 also has 4)

COLLECTOR.records_in_manifest: git identity, spec sha256, run fingerprint, seed-registry blocks, pole identity, allocator, acting pins, KL teacher pins, dataset_tag, per-shard counts
COLLECTOR.crash_recovery: --resume reuses shards whose embedded fingerprint matches exactly
